title: Stalking
grade_or_penalty: 4th degree; 3rd degree if it violates a court order, follows a prior stalking conviction, or occurs while on parole, probation or bail for a crime
key_points: Purposely or knowingly engaging in a course of conduct directed at a specific person that would cause a reasonable person to fear for their own or a third person's safety or to suffer significant emotional distress.
Course of conduct means two or more acts, including following, monitoring, surveillance, threats or communications.
